dx_dlbcl_non_gcb.quote: Non-germinal-center B-cell phenotype by Hans algorithm

dx_hans_not_abc.note: Calls it "ABC-like by Hans" and recommends GEP cell-of-origin but never explicitly states IHC is not equivalent to molecular ABC.

dx_not_breast_recurrence.quote: This is a new lymphoma, not a breast cancer recurrence: AE1/AE3 and GATA3 are negative in the lesional cells

stage_iii.quote: Ann Arbor stage III-B-S (Lugano stage III).

stage_spleen_lymphatic.quote: spleen counted as a nodal/lymphoid site, so S modifier and not stage IV

stage_b_symptoms.quote: B symptoms present: fevers to 38.4 C, 38.2 C on 2026-09-15, and drenching night sweats

stage_bulk_definition.quote: below the 10 cm Lugano bulky threshold but at the 7.5 cm threshold used in some protocols

mn_stage_iv.quote: If the splenic nodules were judged extranodal the stage would be IV, which would change the IPI by one point; I do not think that reading applies here.

mol_del_not_dh.quote: Double-expressor phenotype (MYC IHC 45%, BCL2 IHC 70%). Interphase FISH negative for MYC, BCL2 and BCL6 rearrangements, so this is not double-hit or triple-hit lymphoma.

mn_da_epoch.quote: it does not meet the double-hit definition and does not by itself indicate DA-EPOCH-R

prog_ipi_2.quote: Classic IPI 2 (low-intermediate): age 59 (0), LDH elevated (1), stage III (1), ECOG 1 (0)

prog_cns_ipi_2.quote: CNS-IPI 2 (intermediate): LDH elevated (1) and stage III (1)

cns_no_routine_prophylaxis.quote: Routine CNS-directed prophylaxis (intrathecal methotrexate or high-dose methotrexate) is not indicated on current criteria

mn_mandates_cns_prophylaxis.quote: Routine CNS-directed prophylaxis (intrathecal methotrexate or high-dose methotrexate) is not indicated on current criteria

tx_cardiac_aware_no_full_dox.quote: No anthracycline-containing regimen (R-CHOP-21, pola-R-CHP or DA-EPOCH-R) should be given at this time.

mn_standard_dox_ignores_heart.quote: No anthracycline-containing regimen (R-CHOP-21, pola-R-CHP or DA-EPOCH-R) should be given at this time.

tx_cardioprotection.quote: ACE inhibitor, ARB or ARNI (preferred for BP and LV function), an evidence-based beta-blocker

tx_anthracycline_free_curative.quote: My decision is an anthracycline-free regimen
tx_anthracycline_free_curative.note: Chooses off-label pola-R-CVP rather than the standard R-CEOP/R-GCVP; still curative anthracycline-free with R-CVP fallback.

tx_lower_efficacy_ack.quote: the anthracycline-free regimen probably carries a somewhat lower cure rate than standard therapy

tx_cardiac_monitoring.quote: repeated after cycle 3 and at the end of treatment, and sooner for symptoms or troponin/NT-proBNP rise
tx_cardiac_monitoring.note: Serial echo/GLS planned; troponin/NT-proBNP are baseline and trigger-based rather than clearly scheduled serially.

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: End-of-treatment PET-CT 3-6 weeks after cycle 6, with Deauville 1-3 defining complete metabolic response

sup_tls_allopurinol.quote: TLS: intermediate risk (bulky disease, elevated LDH, rituximab-chemotherapy). Use allopurinol (or febuxostat) from day -1, with low-volume hydration

sup_gcsf.quote: I would give primary G-CSF from cycle 1

sup_anastrozole.quote: Anastrozole: continue to the planned 10-year endpoint (November 2026) for breast cancer; it has no meaningful interaction with the lymphoma regimen

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: Hepatitis B: HBsAg, anti-HBc and anti-HBs are nonreactive, so no antiviral prophylaxis is required for rituximab

fit_curative_ecog1.quote: her overall fitness supports curative-intent therapy

miss_cardiac_workup.quote: no cardiac MRI, ECG, troponin or NT-proBNP are in the record; no coronary assessment
